maria: quick heads-up — I merged a patch that changed how console permission predicates are evaluated (switch from legacy role_bits -> role_predicate). rolling out to prod now :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alex: link? can you paste the predicate diff here?
maria: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/+/r12345 yes — main change is we now evaluate explicit perms before inherited group bits. small diff:
```
- has_role(user, 'viewer') || group_bits & VIEWER != 0
+ eval_permission_predicate('viewer', user, resource)
```
alex: hmm that ordering might break some old service accounts that relied on group_bits fallthrough. any tests?
maria: unit + integration ran green, but e2e for org-admin paths still queued. deploying canary to 10% now.
jamal (sec): seeing an anomaly in audit logs: several requests from token sa-eng-legacy returned allow for project-edit yesterday at 03:12 UTC. Not yet sure if it's the new predicate or unrelated.
maria: interesting — can you paste an example request id?
jamal (sec): req id r-09ff3b7, user=sa-eng-legacy, path=/projects/42/settings, outcome=ALLOW. I replayed locally with current prod code and it denies. after switching to branch with the new predicate it allows.
taylor: tagging SRE — @deploy-bot can you confirm canary percentage and whether we should pause?
deploy-bot: deployment r12345 to console-service: canary=10% -> 10% healthy. paused=FALSE.
alex: OK that reproduces. this is an edge-case: legacy service accounts encoded role bits expecting fallthrough when no explicit policy present. the new predicate returns "false" for missing assertions, then fallback logic mistakenly allows when we check group bit OR predicate in the wrong order in one helper.
maria: proposed fix: change helper to short-circuit the OR the other way and add explicit deny default. i'll draft a rollback-safe patch.
jamal (sec): we should treat this as security incident until we confirm scope. marking P2 for now. need to: 1) determine blast radius 2) rotate affected tokens 3) add audit filter to identify similar matches 4) hold canary.
taylor: creating incident thread and runbook updates. I'm on blast-radius. alex take token rotation? maria prepare patch and CI tests. jamal write an audit query.
alex: on it — will schedule rotation for sa-eng-legacy and other legacy-* tokens. quick question: do we rotate KMS-wrapped tokens or just revoke at auth layer?
jamal (sec): revoke at auth layer first (fast), then rekey KMS-wrapped secrets as part of postmortem if needed. update KMS access logs for the suspect keys — looks like key arn arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abc-legacy was used 03:10-03:20 UTC.
maria: patch ready: switch OR ordering and add explicit default deny + test for legacy bit fallthrough. PR r12346. canary paused?
taylor: pausing canary now. deploy-bot: canary paused by taylor at 2278459099.
deploy-bot: rollback option available: r12344 (pre-change).
alex: I'll rotate tokens first then we can either promote fix or roll back. rotation script dropping in ops-runbook: `/scripts/rotate-tokens --filter "legacy-*" --dry-run`
jamal (sec): audit query (stacklight): `SELECT req_id, user, outcome FROM audit_logs WHERE outcome='ALLOW' AND path LIKE '/projects/%/settings' AND timestamp > '2025-11-05T02:00:00Z'` — returning 7 hits so far.
maria: thanks. note for postmortem: add a lint that prevents switching evaluation semantics without an explicit migration flag. also add an e2e that simulates legacy service-accounts.
taylor: assigned owners: jamal (scope + audit), alex (token rotation + revoke), maria (fix + tests + PR), taylor (coordinate incident comms). I'll open an incident doc in /incidents and ping legal if we see external exposure.
alex: doing rotation now; will post updates.
maria: PR merged to hotfix branch with tests. ready to re-run canary when tokens are rotated.
jamal (sec): initial rotation done for sa-eng-legacy. audit shows 2 previously-allowed requests — both internal automation, no external exfil. marking potential impact low but keeping P2 until full rotation done.
taylor: thanks team. follow-ups: (a) postmortem template (maria), (b) KMS key audit (jamal), (c) add migration flag + lint (maria), (d) add e2e for legacy-account paths (alex).
maria: adding todos to PR and postmortem doc. closing thread when incident record updated.
deploy-bot: deployment r12345: canary resumed? False — waiting for manual resume.
